lessons.lesson: Run all five actual summary, anatomy and wallet probes before full documents.
lessons.mechanism: The early probe caught three summary overflows, two anatomy-page contact/footer overflows and two long-title wallet overflows before the complete batch. Preserve the failed candidates and correct the actual section-specific cause with fixed fonts and existing page/card contracts.

lessons.lesson: Keep mixed monitoring source bases explicit; consolidate only exact duplicate titles.
lessons.mechanism: All25named test/timing rows retain their own Regimen, product or individual-plan labels. Nine repeated phase titles are retained once as exact visible chart captions; all phase paragraphs remain. The verifier pins the actual profile/title/caption DOM and rejects unmatched or missing units.

lessons.lesson: Freeze and test the actual stylesheet order and the final assembled guide.
lessons.mechanism: Source-decorated probe pages match the initial pack pixel-for-pixel. The inherited book builder can still reflow summary spacing, so compare anatomy/record pixels and inspect each actual final summary before delivery.

lessons.lesson: Check complete authored generic consent paragraphs in extracted PDFs, across page boundaries.
lessons.mechanism: A checklist alone does not establish retention. Exact generic and context paragraphs, every named agent section and all source units must survive; the00675generic paragraph was also visually reviewed across its page1/2 break.

lessons.lesson: Separate exact web-navigation controls from clinical retention.
lessons.mechanism: Only the five source-pinned browser/download labels are omitted from offline books. Retain138clinical units and5metadata units, with zero unresolved source clauses.

lessons.lesson: Challenge shared supportive-care language against each regimen and phase.
lessons.mechanism: Root actual-page review exposed a vincristine-only sentence in00504, which contains no vincristine. Preserve the finding, independently check the national sources, remove only the incorrect sentence, and verify both its absence in00504 and its continued presence in applicable00757documents.

lessons.lesson: Rebuild only actual consumers and preserve unchanged outputs with explicit input proof.
lessons.mechanism: The00504correction affected one support PDF and one book/reference assembly. The other31companions and four books reused verified identical bytes, then passed current-source final checks.

lessons.lesson: Settle derived knowledge-print HTML after book publication.
lessons.mechanism: These browser-print pages are output artifacts excluded from PDF inputs. Apply only the established output transform, prove text/DOM/SVG equivalence, and protect frozen inputs and all114PDFfiles before final design checks.

lessons.lesson: Handle a pre-process transport failure as one observed incident.
lessons.mechanism: One exec transport failure occurred before process creation. Root performed one bounded healthy probe; the targeted command was then created once and completed. No duplicate rendering or permission retry loop was started.

known_environment: The browser socket preflight remains blocked; no unchanged browser permission retries.
limits: Bounded logs, hashes and persisted checkpoints improve recovery but do not guarantee platform or background-job availability.
